request_flow.summary: The exact-raw HMAC webhook path validates the fixture vocabulary and resolves the original qualified payment transaction and reference. An independent connection must see the bounded receipt before acknowledgement.
The receipt worker locks the accepted purchase, binds the provider dispute identity, classifies revision or conflict and increments the durable effect version in the same transaction.
The owning Entitlements transaction re-reads the current source effect. Applied versions are acknowledged separately, so a cut between transactions leaves recoverable work.

The projection binds exact signed scope claims and checks current session, persisted Privacy purpose and deletion authority. Audit records the exact operation, actor, dispute, purpose and field set. An independent connection must see that committed assertion before the projection returns. Explicit caller transactions are denied.

security_invariants.summary: Dispute wire, handlers, workers, Ash actions and AshOban read authorization compile only in TEST. Network reads are GET to the original certificate-pinned loopback endpoint, without redirects or automatic retries.

The stored receipt contains only a digest, bounded normalized outcome data and a local bound payment identity. SQL query telemetry is suppressed on protected paths including the independent visibility observer.

Privacy suppresses restricted SQL telemetry around authority reads, grant and withdrawal writes and events, proof issuance, and failure reconciliation. The same bounded observer that checks receipt visibility also checks exact Audit visibility with protected SQL telemetry.

concurrency.summary: The purchase lock is shared by dispute ingress, qualification, refund dispatch claim and entitlement convergence. A pending bound receipt or current blocking dispute fences a new POST. An existing claim remains durable and cannot be repeated.

Dispute receipt persistence and terminal qualification take the same purchase lock. Precommitted opposing outcomes keep a known case suspended with the refund fence held in either processing order. The first terminal receipt for a still-unbound case binds as unresolved when its opposition is already committed. Loss qualified before opposition remains irreversible.

Refund claim and dispute delivery use the same Purchase lock. The refund owner's payment-scoped status keeps a restored dispute financially unresolved after an ambiguous, pending or failed claimed POST. Entitlements suspends the affected Plan right and ends it after qualified processed refund evidence. A delivery that commits first can restore access while clear, and the committed claim then fences reads before the next effect delivery.

idempotency_retry.summary: Dispute identity and immutable receipt identity are separate. Replays of earlier revisions or obsolete read tokens cannot advance the owning case. The durable scheduled retry remains capped and due after the final round.
A later exact pinned confirmation covers older opposing revisions. An older disagreement with no newer pinned confirmation can still open a conflict.

failure_recovery.summary: Receipt processing, due known-case reads and pending consequences remain queryable by TEST workers after process loss or missing/discarded jobs. A separate process verifies fresh-BEAM recovery.
Down migrations refuse to discard retained dispute, Privacy or Audit evidence or suspended rights. Cleanup selects only the tracked operation, exact payment or webhook digest and their jobs.

A stale read token prevents its receipt from applying an outcome. Its committed exact-source terminal revision still limits confirmation. A current pinned read can resolve an unsettled conflict when its revision is at least as high as same-outcome evidence and strictly newer than every opposing terminal revision. Repeating the same terminal outcome under a current reservation can apply after a superseded attempt.

AshOban 0.10.2 remains pinned. These triggers use generic actions. The owning code revalidates pending receipt, due read and effect state under the Purchase lock. The 0.10.3 update and destroy worker recheck change is distinct from those guards. Fresh BEAM proof executes the current pinned scheduler and workers.

prohibited_shortcuts.summary: Do not infer component identity from a partial amount, classify financial settlement from access state, retry a claimed POST or create a right during correction delivery.
Do not disclose raw participant information, send evidence outside NewYou, activate Paystack or discover unknown disputes.

proof_limitations: Actual Paystack account configuration, dispute status and deadline vocabulary, Finance operations and release certification remain out of scope.
The local fixture records unresolved overlapping corrections and does not decide cancellation, netting or external adjudication.

Ash Signals and Temporal Resources were considered. The existing versioned Commerce consequence and immutable receipts provide scoped durable recovery and historical evidence without process-local authority or new dependencies.

Finance and Audit are signed TEST fixture claims. Persisted revocation proof applies to the Privacy purpose and canonical session; the fixture has no independent role-revocation state. Revisions order fixture observations only.
